patch_description: Adjacent swaps can only fix local ordering issues; many suboptimal schedules have a small block of 1–3 transactions that belongs elsewhere. Adding an Or-opt pass (remove a segment of length 1–3 and try reinserting it at every other position), alternating with adjacent-swap hill climbing, explores a much richer neighborhood while staying within the time budget. Each candidate is evaluated exactly via `get_opt_seq_cost`, so improvements always reflect the true makespan. This should reduce makespan further and raise the combined score.
